name: Browse abandonment
purpose: Brings back someone who looked and left.

steps.ask: Clicked any email in the last 24 hours, or already got this reminder today?

steps.name: The second look
steps.job: Shows what they viewed, with a small one-time code.
steps.subject: Still thinking it over?

rules: Skips anyone who started a checkout in the last 4 hours. The cart flow has them.
Staff and test addresses are filtered out.
why: One email only. Browsing is a weak signal, so it gets a light touch.
watch: Without the split, a frequent browser gets this every day.
